entities.summary: Birmingham Town Hall is a concert hall and venue for popular assemblies opened in 1834 and situated in Victoria Square, Birmingham, England. It is a Grade I listed building. Birmingham Town Hall is a performing arts building in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
